Steps.Message:
Sent by Jack at 19:10 - I'm pleased to confirm that all power in the Chessmount Rise area should be back on. The issue was caused by an unexpected underground cable fault, which our engineers have managed to do enough repairs to safely restore power and will continue works on the underground cable behind the scenes.

Steps.Name: Customer Service Team

Steps.Message:
Our engineers have been in touch to say they no longer need the temporary generator that we were sending out and are now planning to go full the full repair as they believe this will be a quicker option restore power.

We will do our best to provide additional care and support whilst work continues to get your power back on asap. Sent by Jack at 18:44.
Steps.Name: Customer Service Team

I know another delay is frustrating; our engineers always try to give us the best estimate that they can but due to the safety elements of working with live electricity, sometimes they have to adjust their repairs at short notice.

I'm sorry if this has caused you to change any plans you've made, but we'll be here to update you until the lights are safely back on.
